entries.423c022b994adb42: Among cable TV operators, the shift of access lines to FTTH is advancing, and the expansion of 10Gbps service areas and the introduction of whole-building bulk-type services for apartment complexes are progressing. entries.4469298ad22f56a4: This division selects optimal equipment for systems and sells it to cable television operators, telecommunications carriers and ISPs. entries.4c16a55d93281709: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥242 million, down 55.7% year on year.
